mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, content, image_path) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, #{imagePath})
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE id > #{afterId}

SELECT p.id AS id, p.content AS content, p.image_path AS image_path, p.created_at AS created_at, p.updated_at AS updated_at, u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, u.display_name AS author_display_name, u.icon_image_path AS author_icon_image_path, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS like_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM likes l2 WHERE l2.post_id = p.id AND l2.user_id = #{currentUserId}) AS liked_by_me FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id AS id, p.content AS content, p.image_path AS image_path, p.created_at AS created_at, p.updated_at AS updated_at, u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, u.display_name AS author_display_name, u.icon_image_path AS author_icon_image_path, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS like_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM likes l2 WHERE l2.post_id = p.id AND l2.user_id = #{currentUserId}) AS liked_by_me FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.content ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id AS id, p.content AS content, p.image_path AS image_path, p.created_at AS created_at, p.updated_at AS updated_at, u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, u.display_name AS author_display_name, u.icon_image_path AS author_icon_image_path, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS like_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM likes l2 WHERE l2.post_id = p.id AND l2.user_id = #{currentUserId}) AS liked_by_me FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.user_id = #{currentUserId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_id = #{currentUserId} AND f.following_id = p.user_id) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
